Doduo

Normal Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Doduo is a Normal/Flying-type Twin Bird Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 39.2 kg. It evolves into Dodrio. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 310.
